Without, except (with acc., instr. or abl.); यथा तानं विना रागो यथा मानं विना नृपः . यथा दानं विना हस्ती तथा ज्ञानं विना यतिः Bv. 1. 119; पंकैर्विना सरो भाति सदः खलजनैर्विना . कटुवर्णैर्विना काव्यं मानसं विषयैर्विना 1. 116; विना वाहनहस्तिभ्यः क्रियतां सर्वमोक्षः Mu. 7; Śi. 2. 9. वि-˚निश्चायिन् mfn. settling finally, deciding, Sarvad.
वि—निश्चल mfn. immovable, firm, steady, Vikr.; Kathās.
वि-निश्-√ चर् P. -चरति, to go forth in all directions, ŚBr.; MBh.
वि-निश्चय m. deciding, settling, ascertainment, settled opinion, decision, firm resolve regarding (gen. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c. (अङ्ग-व्˚, the fixing or settling of a horoscope, MW.)
a: विनिश्चयः — 1 Fixing, settling, ascertainment. --2 A decision, resolution.

m: वि-निश्चय—ज्ञ mfn. knowing the certainty of anything, MBh.
वि-निश्-√ चि (only ind.p. -चित्य), to debate about, deliberate, consider, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to determine, resolve, decide, BhP.
a: विनिश्चि — {c5c} U. To determine, resolve, ascertain; विनिश्चेतुं शक्यो न सुखमिति वा दुःखमिति वा U. 1. 36.

m: वि-निश्चि˚तार्थ mfn. having a decided meaning, Bhartṛ.
वि-निश्चित mfn. firmly resolved upon (comp.), MBh.
ascertained, determined, settled, certain, ib.; R. &c.
वि-निश्चितम् ind. most certainly, decidedly, Amar.
वि-˚निश्वास m. breathing hard, sighing, a sigh, W.
a: विनिश्वासः — Hard breathing or respiration, sighing, a sigh.

m: वि-नि-√ श्वस् (cf. वि-निः-√ श्वस्) P. -श्वसिति, to breathe hard, snort, hiss, R.; Bhaṭṭ.; to sigh deeply, MBh.; R.
वि-˚निश्वसित n. exhalation, Jātakam.
वि-नि-बन्ध m. (√ बन्ध्) the being attached or attachment to anything, Buddh.
वि-नि-बर्हण mfn. (√ 1. बृह्) throwing down, crushing, MBh.
वि-˚निबर्हिन् mfn. id., ib.

s: tri, (vigatA nidrA mudranA yasya .) unmIlitaH । iti SabdamAlA ॥ (yaTA, nEzaDe । 1 । 34 । “vinidraromAjani SfRvatI nalam ॥” taTA ca sA hatyadarpaRe । 10 paricCede । “utpattirindorapi nizPalEva dfzwA vinidrA nalinI na yena ॥”) nidrArahitaH । (yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 285 । 21 । “svasTamAsInamavyagraM vinidraM rAkzasADipaH । tato'bravIddaSagrIvaH kumBakarRaM mahAbalam ॥”)
v: tri॰ vigatA nidrA yasya । 1 prakASite SabdamA॰ । 2 nidrAhIne ca । tasya BAvaH । tvA vinidratva praboDe na॰ hemaca॰ ।
m: वि—निद्र mf(आ)n. sleepless, awake, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (also -क, Kathās.)
occurring in the waking condition, Kathās.
passed sleeplessly, Kāv.
expanded, blown, Śiś.
opened (as the eyes), Vikr.
वि—निद्र m. a partic. formula recited over weapons, R.
वि-निद्र &c. See p. 951, col. 1.
a: विनिद्र — a. 1 Sleepless, awake (fig. also); तामेकतस्तव बिभार्त्ति गुरुर्विनिद्रः R. 5. 66. --2 Budded, opened, full-blown, expanded; विनिद्रमंदाररजोरुणांगुली Ku. 5. 80.

m: वि—निद्र—ता f. (Bhpr.) sleeplessness, wakefulness, vigilance.

s: klI, (vinidrasya BAvaH .) praboDaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ nidrArahitatvaYca ॥
m: वि—निद्र—त्व n. (L.) sleeplessness, wakefulness, vigilance.
वि-˚निगूहित mfn. (fr. Caus.) covered, concealed, hidden, VarBṛS.
वि-˚निगूहितृ m. one who conceals, keeper (of a secret), MBh.
वि-नि-√ गद् P. -गदति, to speak to, address, Sāh. : Pass. -गद्यते, to be called or named, ib.
वि-नि-गमक mfn. (√ गम्) deciding between two alternatives, Kap., Sch.

s: strI, ekatarapakzapAtinI yuktiH । ekatarAvaDAraRA । yaTA । ucyate । ekadeSopAttasyEva BUhiraRyAdAvutpannasya svatvasya vinigamanApramARABAvena vESezikavyavahArAnarhatayA avyavasTitasya guwikApAtAdinA vyaYjanaM viBAgaH । iti dAyaBAgaH ॥ ucyata iti BUhiraRyAdAvutpannasya ekadeSopAttasya tattadaMSAvacCinnasya vinigamanA idamamukasya nAnyasyetyavaDAraRarUpA tatpramARaBAvena vESezikavyavahAraH parasparanErapekzeRa dAnavikrayAdilakzaRastadanarhatayA avyavasTitasya sato'pyasatkalpasya guwikApAtAdinA vyaYjanaM idaM amukasyetyavaDAraRaM viBAga ityarTaH । iti tawwIkAyAM SrIkfzRatarkAlaNkAraH ॥
m: वि-˚नि-गमना f. decision between two alternatives, Śaṃk.
वि—निगड mfn. free from foot-fetters (˚डी-√ कृ, to unfetter), Daś.
a: विनिगड — a. Without fetters, unrestrained, free.

m: वि-˚निग्राह्य mfn. to be stopped or restrained, MBh.
वि-नि-√ ग्रह् (only ind.p. -गृह्य), to lay hold of, seize, keep back, restrain, impede, MBh.
a: विनिग्रह् — {c9c} U. 1 To restrain, check; obstruct, impede. --2 To lay hold of, seize.

m: वि-˚निग्र˚हार्थीय mfn. standing in the sense of the above antithesis, ib.
वि-˚निग्र˚हार्थ m. the sense of the above antithesis, ib.
वि-˚निग्रह m. separation, division, Nir.
restraining, checking, stopping, subduing, controlling, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
restriction, limitation, L.
disjunction, mutual opposition, an antithesis which implies that when two propositions are antithetically stated peculiar stress is laid on one of them, MW.
a: विनिग्रहः — 1 Restraining, curbing, subduing; Bg. 13. 7, 17. 16; Ms. 9. 263. --2 Mutual opposition or antithesis.

m: वि-नि-√ गुह् P. -गूहति, to cover over, conceal, hide, MBh.; R.
वि-नि-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, to strike down, slay, slaughter, kill, destroy, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वि-निहत mfn. struck down &c.
dispelled (as darkness), MBh.
disregarded (as a command), R.
afflicted, distressed (as the mind), MBh.
वि-निहत m. a great or unavoidable calamity, infliction caused by fate or heaven, W.
a portent, comet, meteor, ib.
a: विनिहत — p. p. 1 Struck down, wounded. --2 Killed. --3 Completely overcome. --तः 1 Any great or unavoidable calamity, such as that inflicted by fate or heaven. --2 A portent, comet.

m: वि-निहि˚तात्मन् mfn. disagreeing (in mind), not assenting, Āpast.
वि-निहित mfn. put or laid down, placed or fixed upon, directed towards (loc. or comp.), Bhartṛ.; Gīt.
appointed to (loc.), Hariv.
separated, turned off (see ˚तात्मन्)
वि-निहित—दृष्टि mfn. one who has the eyes fixed upon, eagerly looking at, Mṛcch.
वि-निहित—मनस् mfn. one who has the mind fixed upon, intent upon, devoted to, Gīt.
वि-नि-√ ह्नु P. -ह्नौति, to deny, disown, MBh. xiii, 5521 (w.r. ह्नोति).
विनि-˚ह्नुत mfn. denied, disowned, hidden, concealed, Kāv.; Kathās.
वि-√ निज् (only aor. व्य्-अनिजम्), to wipe off, AV. x, 4, 19.
वि-˚निकार m. offence, injury, MBh.
वि-नि-√ कॄ (only ind.p. -कीर्य), to cast off, abandon, Kum.
a: विनिकॄ — {c6c} A. 1 To throw, abandon, cast off; Ku. 4. 6. --2 To throw about, scatter.

m: वि-˚निकीर्ण mfn. thrown asunder, scattered, dispersed, broken, MBh.; R.
covered, filled, crowded with (instr. or comp.), R.; Ragh.
a: विनिकीर्ण — p. p. Scattered, thrown about.

m: वि-˚निकर्त्तव्य mfn. to be cut down, ib.
वि-नि-कषण n. (√ कष्) scratching, scraping, Daśar.
वि—निकेत mfn. having no fixed abode, KāśīKh.
वि-नि-√ कृ P. Ā. -करोति, -कुरुते, to act badly towards, ill-treat, offend, Mn. ix, 213.
वि-˚निकृन्तन mfn. cutting in pieces, hewing down, ib.
वि-नि-√ कृत् P. -कृन्तति, to cut or hew in pieces, cut away, tear off, destroy, MBh.
वि-˚निकृत mfn. ill-treated, injured, damaged, MBh.; R.
वि-˚निकृत्त mfn. cut away, torn off, R.
वि-नि-कोचन n. (√ कुच्) contraction (of the brows), Bhpr.
वि-√ निक्ष् P. -निक्षति (Ved. inf. -निक्षे), to pierce, penetrate, RV.; AV.
वि-˚निक्षण n. the act of piercing, Nir. iv, 18.
वि-˚निक्षेप m. tossing, throwing, sending, W.
separation, isolation (गुण-विनिक्षेप-तस्, with regard to the qualities singly or separately), Car.
a: विनिक्षेपः — Throwing down, sending forth.

m: वि-˚निक्षेप्य mfn. to be thrown into (loc.), MBh.

वि-नि-√ क्षिप् P. Ā. -क्षिपति, ˚ते, to throw or put down, infix, insert, fasten, Yājñ.; R.; (with मनस्) to fix the mind upon (loc.), MBh.; to deposit, entrust with, ib.; to charge with, appoint to (loc.), ib.
a: विनिक्षिप् — {c6c} A. 1 To entrust, deliver over. --2 To place in or upon. --3 To throw down, overthrow. --4 To engage in.

s: tri, vinikzepASrayaH । parityaktaH । vinipUrvvakakzipaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannaH ॥ (yaTA, devIBAgavate । 2 । 8 । 27 । “pituH kaRWe'dya me yena vinikzipto mftoragaH ॥”)
m: वि-˚निक्षिप्त mfn. thrown or put down &c.
(ifc.) placed in or under, ŚārṅgP.
वि-नि-मीलन n. (√ मील्) shutting, closure (of a flower, of the eyes &c.), Ratnāv.; Dharmaś.
वि-˚निमीलित mfn. closed, shut
वि-˚निमीलि˚तेक्षण mfn. having the eyes closed, Bhaṭṭ.; Kathās.
वि-नि-मग्न mfn. (√ मज्ज्) dived under, bathed or immersed in (loc.), BhP.

s: puM, (vi + ni + mI + ap .) paridAnam । pratidAnam । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 1 । 26 । “dudoha gAM sa yajYAya SasyAya maGavA divam । sampadvinimayenoBO daDaturBuvanadvayam ॥”) banDakaH । iti SabdamAlA ॥ yaTA, -- “vikrayErgAM vinimayErdattvA gomAMsaKAdake । vrataM cAndrAyaRaM kuryyAdvaDe sAkzAdvaDI Bavet ॥” iti prAyaScittatattvaDftagoBilavacanam ॥
v: pu॰ vi + ni + mi--ac । parivartte 1 tulyadravyadAnena dravyAntaragrahaRe Sabdaca॰ । 2 banDaka ca SabdamA॰ ।
m: वि-नि-मय m. (√ मे) exchange, barter (एन, alternately), Āpast.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
mutual engagement, reciprocity (see कार्य-विन्˚)
a pledge, deposit, security, L.
transmutation (of letters), MW.
a: विनिमयः — 1 Exchange, barter; कार्यविनिमयेन M. 1; संपद्विनिमयेनोभौ दधतुर्भुवनद्वयं R. 1. 26. --2 A pledge, deposit, security. --3 Transmutation (of letters).

m: वि-नि-मेष m. (√ मिष्) winking or twinkling of the eyes, a wink, sign, Kir.
a: विनिमेषः — Twinkling(of the eyes).

m: वि-˚निमेषण n. id., ib.
वि—निमित्त mfn. having no real cause, not caused by anything, Car.
वि-√ निन्द् (or निद्), P. -निन्दति, to reproach, revile, abuse, MBh.; Pur.
वि-˚निन्दा f. reproach, abuse, VP.
वि-˚निन्द mfn. mocking (= surpassing, exceeding), Pañcar.
वि-˚निन्दक mfn. blaming, censuring, Subh.
scoffing, deriding, MārkP.
mocking i.e. surpassing, Gīt.

s: puM, (viSezeRa nipatanam । vi + ni + pata + GaY .) nipAtaH । dEvAdivyasanam । iti medinI । te, 217 ॥ avamAnaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, manO । 4 । 146 । “maNgalAcArayuktAnAM nityaYca prayatAtmanAm । japatAM juhvatAYcEva vinipAto na vidyate ॥”)
v: pu॰ vi + ni + pata--GaY । 1 nipAte 2 dEvAdikfte vyasane medi॰ 3 apamAne ca hemaca॰ ।
m: वि-˚निपात m. falling down, falling, L.
a great fall, ruin, loss, calamity, Mn.; MBh. &c.
death, Hcar.
frustration, Subh.
failure (see अ-विन्˚)
a: विनिपातः — 1 Falling down, a fall. --2 A great fall, calamity, an evil, loss, ruin, destruction; विवेकभ्रष्टानां भवति विनिपातः शतमुखः Bh. 2. 10 (where it has sense 1 also); विधिहेतुरहेतुरागसां विनिपातोपि समः समुन्नतेः Ki. 2. 34. --3 Decay, death. --4 Hell, perdition; Ś. 5. --5 Occurrence, happening. --6 Pain, distress. --7 Disrespect. --Comp. --शंसिन् a. portentous, foreboding ruin.

m: वि-˚निपात—शंसिन् mfn. announcing m˚ or destruction, portentous, W.
वि-˚निपात—गत mfn. fallen into misfortune, R.
वि-˚निपातक mfn. throwing down, causing to fall, destroying, MBh.
वि-˚निपातन n. causing miscarriage, Harav.
वि-˚निपात—प्रतीकार m. (Pañcat.) a remedy against m˚
वि-˚निपात—प्रतिक्रिया f. (Kathās.) a remedy against m˚
वि-˚निपातिन् See अ-विन्˚.
वि-˚निपातित mfn. thrown down, killed, destroyed, R.
वि-नि-√ पीड् Caus. -पीडयति, to torment, harass, annoy, MBh. vi, 3515 (ind.p. विनिपीड्य, with v.l. च निपीड्य).

वि-नि-√ पत् P. -पतति, to fall down, fall in or into (loc.), Hariv.; Sāh.; to flow down, alight upon (loc.), Hariv.; to fall upon, attack, assail, Kathās. : Caus. -पातयति (Pass. -पात्यते), to cause to fall down, strike off (a man's head), MBh.; to throw down, kill, destroy, annihilate, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: विनिपत् — {c1c} P. 1 To fly at, fall down, descend; Rs. 4. 19. --2 To attack, assail. --Caus. 1 To cause to fall down, ruin, destroy; कटेन विनिपातितो यामि Mk. 2. 8. --2 To throw or pull down. --3 To kill, deprive of life.

m: वि-˚निपतित mfn. fallen or flown down &c., Hariv.; Kāv. &c.
वि-नि-√ पट् (only ind.p. -पाट्य), to split open, cleave, sever, BhP.
वि-निर्-भग्न mfn. (√ भञ्ज्) broken asunder, broken down, MBh.
वि-निर्-भग्न—नयन mfn. one who has his eyes dashed out, R.
वि-निर्-√ भर्त्स् (only ind.p. -भर्त्स्य), to threaten or revile, R.; BhP.

s: puM, (viSezeRa nirnAsti BayaM yasya .) sADyagaRaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “mano mantA taTA SAno naro yAnaSca vIryyavAn । vinirBayo nayaScEva haMso nArAyaRo vfzaH । praBuSceti samAKyAtAH sADyAH dvAdaSa pOrvvikAH ॥” iti vahnipurARe kASyapIyavaMSaH ॥ BayarahitaSca ॥
v: tri॰ vinirgataM BayaM yasmAt । 1 BayaSUnye sADyadevagaRaBede pu॰ vahnipu॰ ।
m: वि—निर्भय m. N. of a Sādhya, VahniP.
वि-निर्-√ भिद् (only ind.p. -भिद्य), to split asunder, pierce, shoot through, MBh.; Hariv.
वि-˚निर्भिन्न mfn. split asunder, cleft, opened, pierced, MBh.; Daś.; BhP.
वि—निर्भोग m. N. of a cosmic period, Buddh.
वि-निर्-भोग m. (prob. fr. √ 3. भुज्) N. of a partic. cosmic period, Buddh.
वि-निर्-√ भुज् (only ind.p. -भुज्य), to bend or turn on one side, Suśr.
वि-निर्-√ धू (only ind.p. -धूय), to shake off, drive or blow away, scatter, R.; to shake about, agitate, ib.; to reject, repudiate, Vcar.

s: tri, (vi + nir + DU + ktaH .) duravasTayA calitaH । yaTA, -- “tato devA vinirDUtA BrazwarAjyAH parAjitAH । hftADikArAstridaSAstAByAM sarvve nirAkftAH ॥” iti mArkaRqeye devImAhAtmyam ॥
m: वि-˚निर्धूत mfn. shaken off, BhP.
driven away, MBh.
वि-˚निर्धुत mfn. shaken off or about, tossed, agitated, ib.
वि-निर्-घोष m. (√ घुष्) sound, MBh.
वि-निर्-णी (√ नी; only ind.p. -णीय), to decide or determine clearly, BhP.
a: विनिर्णी — = निर्णी q. v.

m: वि-निर्णीत mfn. determined clearly, ascertained, certain, W.
वि-निर्णय m. complete settlement or decision, certainty, a settled rule, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: विनिर्णयः — 1 Complete settlement or ascertainment, full decision. --2 Certainty. --3 A settled rule.

m: वि—निर्बाहु m. a partic. mode of fighting with a sword, Hariv.
वि-निर्बाहु वि-निर्भय &c. See p. 951, col. 1.

a: विनिर्बंधः — Persistence, pertinacity.

m: वि-निर्-बन्ध m. (√ बन्ध्) persistence or perseverance in (comp.), MBh.; MārkP.
वि-निर्दग्ध mfn. completely burned up or consumed, utterly destroyed, MBh.; R.; Hariv.
वि-निर्-√ दह् P. -दहति, to burn completely, consume by fire, destroy, MBh.; BhP.
वि-निर्दहनी f. a partic. remedy, Suśr.
वि-निर्दहन n. the act of burning or destroying utterly, MW.
वि-˚निर्देश्य mfn. to be announced or reported, VarBṛS.

वि-निर्-√ दिश् P. -दिशति, to assign, destine for (loc.), BhP.; to point out, indicate, state, declare, designate as (two acc.), MBh.; BhP.; Suśr.; to announce, proclaim, Yājñ.; VarBṛS.; to determine, resolve, fix upon, MBh.
वि-˚निर्दिष्ट mfn. pointed out &c.
charged or entrusted with (loc.), R.
वि-निर्-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go out or away, depart or escape from (abl.), MBh.; R. &c.; to be beside one's self, BhP.
a: विनिर्गम् — {c1c} P. 1 To go out. --2 To disappear, vanish. --3 To go away, depart. --4 To escape from, liberate oneself from.

m: वि-निर्गम m. going out, departure from (abl.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
being spread or divulged, spreading abroad, MārkP.
the last of the three divisions of an astrological house, VarBṛS.
a: विनिर्गमः — Disappearance. = {9} Departure.

m: वि-निर्गत mfn. gone out, come forth, issued, R.; VarBṛS. &c.
liberated or freed from (abl.), Mn. viii, 65.
वि-˚निर्गति f. coming forth, issuing, Car.
वि-निर्-हत mfn. (√ हन्) completely destroyed, AV.
वि-निर्-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to take out, extract, Suśr.; to remove, destroy, MBh.
वि-निर्-√ ज्ञा (only Pass. -ज्ञायते), to distinguish, discern, find out, ŚBr.
वि-निर्जय m. complete victory, conquest, MBh.
a: विनिर्जयः — Complete victory.

m: वि-निर्-√ जि P. -जयति, to conquer completely, win, MBh.; R.; to vanquish, defeat, overpower, subdue, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: विनिर्जि — {c1c} P. 1 To conquer completely. --2 To subdue, overpower, master.

m: वि-निर्जित mfn. entirely conquered, subdued, won, ib.; R.; BhP.
वि-निर्-√ लिख् P. -लिखति, to make incisions in, scarify, Suśr.; to scratch or scrape off, free from dirt, Car.
वि-निर्-√ मा (only pf. -ममे, with act. and pass. meaning), to fabricate, create, fashion, form, build, construct out of (instr. or abl.), Bhaṭṭ.; Kathās.
a: विनिर्मा — See निर्मा.

m: वि-˚निर्माण n. meting out, measuring, MBh.
building, forming, creating (ifc. made of formed according to), Kathās.; Rājat.; Pañcar.
वि-˚निर्मातृ m. a maker, builder, creator, MBh.
वि—निर्मूढ mfn. not stultified, not made void or vain, MārkP.
वि—निर्मूढ—प्रतिज्ञ mfn. one who is faithful to a promise or agreement, ib.
वि-निर्-√ मथ् (or मन्थ्; only ind.p. -मथ्य), to churn out, Suśr. ; to crush, annihilate, Kathās.

kept, celebrated, observed (as a feast), R.

discharged, shot off, hurled, R.
वि-˚निर्मुक्ति f. (ifc.) liberation, W.
a: विनिर्मुक्तिः — f. Release, liberation.

turned away, averted, Mālav.

an impression (as of the fingers &c.), Śak.
putting down (in a book) i.e. mentioning, Sarvad.
suitable apportionment or disposition, ŚrS., Sch.
entrance, settling down, MW.

raising, erection, building, Rājat.
arrangement, disposition, ĀpŚr., Sch.
impressing, Yogas., Sch.

placed or fixed in or on (loc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वि-निवेदन n. the act of announcing, announcement, Kathās.
वि-नि˚वेदित mfn. made known, announced, MBh.

a: विनिवृ — {c10c} U. or --Caus. 1 To prevent, ward off, suppress; विनयं विनिवार्य Māl. 1. 18. --2 To prohibit, forbid.

m: वि-नि-√ वृत् Ā. -वर्तते, to turn back, return, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to turn away, desist or cease from (abl.), ib.; to cease, end, disappear, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to be extinguished (as fire), Yājñ.; to be omitted, Lāṭy. : Caus. -वर्तयति, to cause to return, call or lead back from (abl.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to cause to cease or desist from (abl.), R.; MārkP.; to draw back (a missile), MBh.; to avert, divert (the gaze), R.; Mālav.; to give up, abandon, MBh.; R.; to cause to cease, remove, R.; to render ineffective, annul (a curse, fraudulent transactions &c.), ŚvetUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: विनिवृत् — {c1c} A. 1 To turn back, return. --2 To cease, come to an end; सपिंडता तु पुरुषे सप्तमे विनिवर्तते Ms. 5. 60; Bg. 2. 59. --3 To desist, turn away, abstain (from); देवनात्, युद्धात् &c. --Caus. 1 To cause to cease or step, withdraw; Ś. 7. 26. --2 To restrain, withhold. --3 To renounce.

desisting from (abl.), having abandoned or given up, R., disappeared, ended, ceased to be, Hariv.; Kāv.; Kathās.
a: विनिवृत्त — p. p. 1 Returned, turned away. --2 Stopped, ceased, desisted from. --3 Retired.

m: वि-˚निवृत्त—शाप mfn. freed from (the evil effects of) a curse, Kathās.

वि-˚निवृत्ति f. cessation, coming to an end, Mn.; Hariv. &c.
omission, discontinuance, PārGṛ.; Car.
वि-निवृत्ति cessation of work, inactivity, Bcar.
a: विनिवृत्तिः — f. 1 Cessation, stopping, removing; शक्राभ्यसूयाविनिवृत्तये R. 6. 74. --2 End, stop, termination.

m: वि-नि-√ विश् Caus. -वेशयति, to cause to enter into, set down or place in, put on Hariv.; Kāv.; Rājat.; to apply, Kāv.; to appoint to, institute or instal in (loc.), MBh.; to fix (the eyes or thoughts) upon (loc.), MBh.; Hariv.; to fix or erect (a statue), Rājat.; to establish or found (a city), Kum.; to draw up in array (as troops), MBh.; (with करे) to place in tribute, make tributary, MBh.; (with हृदये) to impress on the heart, Rājat.
a: विनिविश् — {c6c} P. To be placed or be seated in. --Caus. 1 To fix, place; Ku. 1. 49; R. 5. 63; मदुरसि कुचकलशं विनिवेशय Gīt. 12. --2 To populate or colonize. --3 To introduce. --4 To add, insert.

m: वि-नि-√ विद् Caus. -वेदयति, to make known, announce, inform, report, MBh.; R.; Kathās.; to offer, present, Hcat.
a: विनिविद् — See निविद्.

m: वि-˚निविष्ट mfn. dwelling or residing in (comp.), VarBṛS.

drawn on (loc.), R.
laid out (as tanks), MBh.

a: विनियम् — {c1c} P. 1 To restrain, check, curb; Bg. 6. 24. --2 To limit, restrict.

m: वि-नियम m. limitation, restriction to (loc.), MBh.
restraint, government, W.
a: विनियमः — Control, restraint, check.

वि-निय˚ताहार mfn. moderate in food or diet, abstemious, R.

retrenched, limited, R. (see comp.)
a: विनियत — p. p. Controlled, checked, restrained, regulated; as in विनियताहार, विनियतवाच् &c.

m: वि-नियत—चेतस् mfn. one who has a controlled or regulated mind, MārkP.

appointment to (loc.), commission, charge, duty, task, occupation, MBh.; R. &c.
employment, use, application (esp. of a verse in ritual), TĀr.; Hariv. &c.
relation, correlation, VPrāt.; Pāṇ. viii, 1, 61 &c.

separation, abandonment, W.
impediment, ib.
a: विनियोगः — 1 Separation, parting, detachment. --2 Leaving, giving up, abandoning. --3 Employment, use, application, disposal; बभूव विनियोगज्ञः साधनीयेषु वस्तुषु R. 17. 67; प्राणायामे विनियागेः &c. --4 Appointment to a duty, commission, charge; विनियोगप्रसादा हि किंकराः प्रभविष्णुषु Ku. 6. 62. --5 An obstacle, impediment.

वि-नियोग—सत्क्रिया f. N. of wk.

commissioned, charged, deputed, R.

(with सख्ये, to chose for a friend); to apply, use, employ, Kāv.; Kathās.; Car.; to eat, Dhūrtas. : Pass. -युज्यते, to be unyoked &c.; to fall to pieces, decay, MBh. : Caus. -योजयति, to appoint or assign to, commit to (loc., or अर्थाय, or अर्थम्), Yājñ.; Hariv. &c.; to entrust anything (acc.) to (loc.), Mn. vii, 226; to offer or present, anything (acc.) to (dat.), Pañcar.; to use, employ, ŚvetUp.; Car.; to perform, Pañcar.

m: वि-˚नियुक्˚तात्मन् mfn. one who has his mind fixed on or directed towards, Kum.
वि-˚नियुक्त mfn. unyoked, disjoined &c.
appointed to, destined for (loc.), Sarvad.
enjoined, commanded, MW.
a: विनियुक्त — p. p. 1 Separated, loosed, detached. --2 Attached to, appointed. --3 Applied to. --4 Commanded, enjoined.

वि-निष्कम्प वि-निष्क्रिय &c. See p. 951, col. 1.

वि-˚निष्क्रान्त mfn. gone forth, come out, MBh.
वि-निष्-√ क्रम् P. Ā. -क्रामति, -क्रमते (ind.p. -क्रम्य), to step forth, go out, issue from (abl.), MBh.; R. &c.
वि—निष्क्रिय mfn. abstaining from ceremonial rites, MW.
वि-निष्-पाद्य mfn. (√ पद्) to be accomplished or effected, MārkP.

वि-निष्पेष m. grinding to pieces, rubbing together, friction, MBh.
a: विनिष्पेषः — Bruising, crushing, grinding.

वि-˚निष्पिष्ट mfn. ground down, crushed into powder, smashed, MBh.; BhP.

विन्ना f. a married woman, Yājñ. i, 85.

of the saint Agastya, MW. (perhaps w.r. for वित्त-प).

a kind of palace, L.

विनोद—मञ्जरि f. N. of wk.

वि-˚नोदन—ता f.

वि-नोद—वत् mfn. amusing, delightful, ib.
वि-नोदिन् mfn. driving away, dispelling, Śak.; Kathās.
amusing, diverting, Kathās.; Pañcar.
वि-˚नोदित mfn. (fr. Caus.) driven away, dispelled, Śiś.; Gīt.
diverted, amused, delighted, R.; Hariv.
allayed, soothed, W.

विनोक्ति See under विना, p. 969.
विन्त m. N. of a partic. divine being, MārkP.
वि-√ नु Ā. -नवते, to go or spread in different directions, RV. x, 22, 9.

वि-√ नुद् P. Ā. -नुदति, ˚ते, to drive away or asunder, scare away, dispel, remove, RV.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; to strike (cords), play (on a musical instrument), BhP. (v.l. वि-तुद्), Caus. -नोदयति, to drive asunder or away, dispel, Śiś.; Gīt.; to spend (time), MBh.; to divert, amuse, entertain, Hariv.; Kāv.; Kathās.; to amuse one's self with, delight in (instr.), Ragh. v, 67.
वि-˚नुद् f. a stroke, thrust, blow, RV. ii, 13, 3.
a: विनुद् — {c6c} P. 1 To strike, pierce. --2 To play on a musical instrument (वीणां, आतोद्यं &c.). --3 To remove, drive away, dispel. --Caus. 1 To remove, drive away, dispel, cast off; तापं विनोदय दृष्टिभिः Gīt. 10; Śi. 4. 66; Ś. 3. 21; Māl. 9. 41. --2 To pass, spend (as time). --3 To divert, amuse, entertain; क्व नु खल्वात्मानं विनोदयामि Ś. 3; लतासु दृष्टिं विनोदयामि Ś. 6; R. 14. 77. --4 To amuse oneself with; लक्ष्मीर्विमोदयाति येन दिगंतलंबी सोपि त्वदाननरुचिं विजहाति चंद्रः R. 5. 67.

वि-न्य्-√ अस् P. -अस्यति (rarely -असति), to put or place down in different places, spread out, distribute, arrange, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to put down, deposit, place or lay on, fix in, turn or direct towards, apply to (loc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to mark or designate by (instr.), Megh.; to entrust or make over to (loc.), Vikr.
a: विन्यस् — {c4c} P. 1 To put down, deposit, place; विन्यस्यंती भुवि गणनया देहलीदत्तषुष्पैः Me. 87; Bk. 3. 3. --2 To fix in or on, direct towards; रामे विन्यस्तमानसाः Rām. --3 To deliver or make over, commit to the care of, entrust; सुतविन्यस्तपत्नीकः Y. 3. 45. --4 To arrange, dispose, adjust.
